entries.hypothesis: portworld has computational-strategy headroom: a cross-fitted public-information portfolio beats the best simple rule and best single method

gates.GA-1: U_hat - best simple rule >= .02 absolute, 95% LB > .005 (one-shot and sequential separately)

entries.baselines: single methods (trace-read budgets), cascades, cheap/expensive-first, thresholds, depth<=3 trees, tuned logistic, strong hand portfolio incl. preprocessing, certified-gap stop, node-count switch, reuse verify/repair, inspect rule; hidden-state oracle ceiling only
entries.selection: best simple rule chosen on inner folds; episode-clustered cross-fitting
entries.worlds: fresh dev population in the 300M-340M range (sub-range assigned by builder)

next.pass: A-SEL (learned selectors A2/A3, >=3 lineages, fresh instances; promotion margin <= half measured headroom)
next.fail: one principled generator revision then close Track A

entries.addendum_before_gate_run: Registered before the gate run on fresh dev_gate seeds (305M-310M, 640 episodes): GA-1/GA-2 unchanged. ALSO REPORTED (not a gate): margin of each learned estimate over the strongest individual simple family (dev: tree depth 2). Dev numbers (builder, 300M seeds, 1,801 instances): sequential GA-1 +.0204 [.0114,.0310] marginal pass, one-shot +.0175 fail; vs tree-depth-2 only +.010-.012. Generator pw-v3; revisions v1 (headroom .0016) and v2 (.0084) documented in portworld.md.

entries.primary: U(A2 or A3) >= U(A1) + margin (<= half of GA-1 headroom; fixed before evaluation) at comparable or lower total compute incl. selector charges, 3/3 lineages, fresh instances; also >= max single method
entries.switch_metrics: unnecessary/justified switches, latency, wasted work, case types (a)-(d) with belief-conditioned values

entries.rule: primary challenge family = untouched triple (probeworld-v3 ranges) with largest minimum per-factor decision relevance subject to global-shift closable fraction <= .5; second passing triple = secondary holdout; historical U+E/S+C/U+C challenge only
entries.expected: S+C+E primary (reviewer local screen), U+C+E secondary — to be confirmed by the official screen before any model run

arms.B2: N broader variety, built by replacement matching B0 per-factor frequency, per-combination share, optimal-first-action mix
arms.dose: 0-3 constituent pairs of the held triple in training

entries.primary: B2 vs B0 at matched volume on the primary held-out triple: octet-conditional accuracy and gap regret (5 seed pairs; >=200 eligible configs; configuration-clustered CIs); must not be explained by global-shift (closable fraction test)
entries.threshold: to be fixed in the protocol addendum after power from dev numbers, before any held-out evaluation

arms: SUPPLIED derived quantities (posterior, expected remaining cost per strategy, P(probe resolves), amortized build value) — localization ceiling
LEARNED: auxiliary heads predicting those quantities, downstream policy consumes predictions
entries.causal: on-manifold interventions changing one factor via valid configurations; policy changes only where expected utility changes

entries.trigger: A2/A3 shows headroom over A1 per GA AND >=50% of learned-selector regret localized to value misestimates of candidate methods
